from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash payment amount for goods and services extracted from its financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount for 购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount as stated (e.g., 元, yuan)")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written in the financial statement")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document containing this data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_items: list[CompanyCashFlow]
